name: Maya Site of Copan
description: Tucked into a green mountain valley in western Honduras, near the Guatemalan border, Copán was the capital of a powerful Maya kingdom from the 5th to 9th centuries. Visitors wander its ruined acropolis and grand plazas, and see the city's distinctive sculptural style. In 738 its famed king was captured and executed by the ruler of rival Quiriguá. The city was abandoned in the early 10th century.
